answer: SilverBullet Desktop's MCP endpoint listens by default on the loopback address `http://127.0.0.1:3999/.mcp`. It is off by default. You can turn it on or change the port under Settings → Advanced → MCP. This comes from `MCP.md`.

[2] MCP.md (Tools)
  Desktop: SilverBullet Desktop serves MCP too, for the spaces registered in the app, on a loopback listener at `http://127.0.0.1:3999/.mcp`. It is off by default. Turn it on or change the port under **Settings → Advanced → MCP**, which also shows the setup commands with your port filled in.
  SilverBullet can act as an [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (Model Context Protocol) server, so AI assistants can read, write, query and pimp up your spaces. / MCP is available in [[Dashboard|multi-space mode]] and in [[Desktop]]. The endpoint is `/.mcp` on your server, for example `https://notes.example.com/.mcp`. A single-space server does not serve it. On a server it is off by default: an admin turns it on in the APIs tab of the [[Dashboard]].
  - SilverBullet Desktop serves MCP for the spaces registered in the app, on a loopback listener at `http://127.0.0.1:3999/.mcp`.

  localhost (http): If you run SilverBullet _locally_ on your machine, this is the easiest option.
